description: Planning-only certification for targeted Lock On execution and reusable Foundry target acquisition.
planning_goal: Implement Quick Tech Lock On as a no-roll targeted canonical action: present committed Lock On with a plain Execute control; resolve an already-targeted Foundry token when exactly one valid target exists; when no target exists, acquire one through the Targeting/Spatial acquisition boundary by activating the Foundry token target tool and waiting for the current user to target a token; preserve target cancellation/failure as transaction failure so the committed action remains pending; execute Lock On through the canonical System Bridge -> Semantic Execution Context -> Execution Transaction spine; apply the authoritative native Lancer lockon status to the resolved target actor through Native Adapter applyStatus without creating Frame Conn shadow status; mark only the exact committed Lock On entry executed after successful native status application; expose the target-acquisition behavior as a reusable runtime adapter suitable for Improvised Attack and future weapon/system actions; preserve existing attack and status behavior.
